sections.zh:
但是[GetAdj]社会并不总是为了向一个目标前进而团结。在过去的几个世纪中，相互竞争的国家间日益紧张的关系最终导致了世界末日的降临，全球性的热核战争夺去了数十亿人的生命并且彻底摧毁了[GetHomeWorldName]的地表。

接下来的数十年中，幸存下来的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断面对着放射性污染、基因突变和暴力团体。正是在这样严酷的熔炉中，[GetName]才真正地被建立并巩固起来，带来了新世界秩序。
sections.en:
But [GetAdj] society was not always united toward a common goal. In centuries past, mounting tensions between competing nations came to an apocalyptic head in a global thermonuclear war that claimed the lives of billions, and forever marred the surface of [GetHomeWorldName].

In the decades to follow, surviving [GetSpeciesNamePlural] faced radiological contamination, mutations, and violent tribalism. It was in this grim crucible that the [GetName] was truly forged, and with it a new world order.
